title: Phone parsing names (batch p1-G06-1: phone_parse P126, pivots_phone P128)

attributes.phone_formats: phone number formats from libphonenumber: {e164, international, national}
attributes.phone_geodescription: libphonenumber geodescription {text, level city|state|country|locality, country, city, uf, state}: Brazilian mobiles give the state only, landlines 'City - UF', non-geographic numbers the country
attributes.phone_br: Brazilian numbering facts read from the E.164 digits: {ddd, ddd_allocated, line_hint mobile|landline|mobile_sme_8digit|pre2016_mobile_missing_ninth_digit|non_geographic|invalid_length|unknown, subscriber_digits, non_geographic {prefix, class, label}}
attributes.phone_ddd: DDD (Brazilian national code) facts from the bundled Anatel table: {code, allocated, uf, ufs, main_city, cities (brasilapi_ddd dataset only), cities_source, coverage, table, uf_time_zones}
attributes.phone_invalid_reason: why libphonenumber does not consider the phone number valid (unallocated DDD, too short, 8-digit mobile without the ninth digit...)
attributes.original_carrier: {name, label}: ORIGINAL carrier of the number block from libphonenumber; number portability is not reflected (never the current operator)
